cases.title: Discover the dataset and read its guide
cases.prompt: Use Tara to identify which Emerald Bay release and measurements I can access. Read its guide before interpreting any data, and state the source citation and license.

hard_criteria.assertion: Record health server_version and list_releases metadata; feature version 0.4.0 alone never grants capability or access.
Select dataset=emerald-bay explicitly for get_guide and all Emerald data tools; pin release and guide_version.
Report only advertised raw_counts, cpm, cpm_log1p, growth_rate_released and differential VISION; do not claim DE or absolute VISION.
Attribute Tahoe Bio, link the EmeraldBay source and CC BY 4.0 license, and distinguish source-data rights from runtime guidance.

cases.title: Raw pseudobulk counts
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay sample {measured_sample} and cell line {cell_line}, report raw pseudobulk counts for {positive_gene} and {second_gene}. Include the exact sample and gene identities and expression population.

hard_criteria.assertion: Request measurement=raw_counts; compare every count exactly with the independently frozen integer oracle.
Preserve (sample, cell_line_internal), returned gene identity, population, n_cells_full, and normalization_total_counts.
Describe a sample-level sum of single-cell raw counts, not an individual cell, mean, DE contrast, TPM or DESeq2 result.

cases.title: CPM with the complete denominator
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay sample {measured_sample}, cell line {cell_line} and gene {positive_gene}, show CPM and the denominator used to compute it.

hard_criteria.assertion: Request measurement=cpm and compare with independently computed 1000000 * raw_counts / full_profile_total.
Compare normalization_total_counts exactly; the denominator sums the entire measured profile, not the requested subset.
Use the fixed calculated-value tolerance in the oracle protocol; do not relabel CPM as DESeq2 normalization.

cases.title: Natural-log normalized expression
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay sample {measured_sample}, cell line {cell_line} and gene {positive_gene}, report log-normalized pseudobulk expression and explain the transformation.

hard_criteria.assertion: Request measurement=cpm_log1p and compare with independent ln(1 + CPM), using the whole-profile denominator.
State the natural logarithm and full-QC pseudobulk population; do not substitute log2, log10, TPM or a per-cell mean.
Keep the raw source/normalization distinction and the source citation.

cases.title: Normalization is invariant to the gene subset
cases.prompt: In Emerald Bay sample {measured_sample} and cell line {cell_line}, get CPM for {positive_gene} alone, then with {second_gene}. Explain whether selecting another gene changes the first gene's value.

hard_criteria.assertion: Make both requested slices and compare all selected values to the independent oracle.
The positive gene CPM and full-profile denominator agree between slices; do not re-normalize the selected columns.
If either result is incomplete or unavailable, state that limitation rather than claiming invariance from missing evidence.

cases.title: Measured zero versus missing measurements
cases.prompt: In Emerald Bay, compare {zero_gene}, {unmeasured_gene} and {unknown_gene} in sample {measured_sample}, cell line {cell_line}; also inspect {positive_gene} at unavailable sample/line {absent_sample}/{absent_line}. Which values are measured zeros and which are unavailable?

hard_criteria.assertion: A measured-axis gene omitted from a measured profile is zero; match the independent source membership and counts.
Vocabulary-only gene is gene_not_measured; unknown gene is gene_not_found; measured gene in absent profile is group_unavailable. Preserve nulls.
Do not fill unavailable values with zero, infer no effect from nulls, or drop absent profiles without disclosure.
Unknown identifiers are proven absent in the independent source snapshot; returned measured/availability flags agree.

cases.title: Ambiguous symbols require resolution
cases.prompt: Use Emerald Bay to report expression for symbol {ambiguous_symbol} at {measured_sample}/{cell_line}. If it maps to several genes, show the candidates and do not choose one for me.

hard_criteria.assertion: Retrieve the full candidate set and compare token/Ensembl identities and resolution_matches with the independent oracle.
Do not select the first or highest token or invent a combined value; ask the user to select an unambiguous identity.
If the expression tool is called, require one gene_ambiguous null-valued record per profile, with no selected token.

cases.title: Combination labels and matched endpoint controls
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay combination {combination_condition}, report {positive_gene} expression at cell line {cell_line} together with its matched endpoint controls. Keep every sample separate and explain where time zero belongs.

hard_criteria.assertion: Discover and retain the complete combination label, concentrations/units, sample and arm; never comma-split or collapse it to a scalar dose.
Retain four distinct endpoint controls and their control_replicate_index values; time zero is not an endpoint control.
Use include_matched_controls=true or equivalent bounded exact sample queries, matching cell line and original selected profiles.
Compare sample/line/gene keys and every count/value against the independent oracle; avoid condition-only joins or control duplication.

cases.title: Identity uncertainty and unavailable annotations
cases.prompt: Resolve Emerald Bay cell line {uncertain_line}, and show the sample metadata for {measured_sample}. Can I treat this line mapping as externally confirmed, or infer drug targets and tissue annotations from these records?

hard_criteria.assertion: Preserve the returned canonical cell_line_internal key, cross-references and identity_provenance_status; internal_derivation_only is not external confirmation.
Compare identity and condition metadata with independent expectations.
Do not invent organ/driver/target/MOA/approval/structure annotations or silently join Tahoe-100M metadata.
Unsupported metadata filters are declined explicitly; no scientific conclusion is inferred from absent annotations.

cases.title: Released five-day growth response
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay sample {measured_sample} and cell line {cell_line}, report the released growth or survival response next to {positive_gene} expression. Explain the populations and whether this is clinical survival or a significance test.

hard_criteria.assertion: Use growth_rate_released (survival is only a source-label alias) and compare the released double exactly; do not recompute the payload.
Identify five-day in-vitro growth response; do not present a clinical survival probability, time-to-event result or Tahoe survival log odds.
Preserve phenotype_population, expression_population, n_cells_minimal, n_cells_full, n_cells_all and has_expression_cells.
No invented p-value or significance flag; do not request significant_only=true or silently restrict growth to expression-available profiles.

cases.title: Differential VISION values and interpretation
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay sample {vision_sample} and cell line {vision_line}, show differential VISION scores for {positive_signature}, {negative_signature} and {near_zero_signature}. State the reference and what the signs mean.

hard_criteria.assertion: Discover exact signatures and request only differential scores; compare every released double and sample/line/signature key with independent expectations.
Require score_kind=differential and value_status=scored for scored rows, including genuine numeric zero or near-zero values.
Explain that scores already subtract the mean matched endpoint-control reference; never subtract controls again.
State dimensionless activity; do not infer p-values, probabilities, target engagement or causal mechanism.

cases.title: VISION time-zero scores and unavailable profiles
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay signature {positive_signature}, inspect endpoint controls, time-zero profile {time_zero_sample}/{time_zero_line}, low-cell profile {low_cell_sample}/{low_cell_line}, and unavailable profile {absent_sample}/{absent_line}. Explain what each returned value represents and distinguish missing scores from zero.

hard_criteria.assertion: Compare exact profile keys and oracle availability classes. Endpoint-control references, below-cell-floor profiles and absent profiles have no differential value; time-zero identity alone does not make a profile unavailable.

Preserve null scores for unavailable profiles and correct value_status, has_expression, scored_differential, is_time_zero, is_control_reference and profile metadata when provided. Do not assume every time-zero profile is scored: below-cell-floor and absent time-zero profiles stay unavailable.
Never infer no pathway response from an unavailable score or substitute an absolute score.

For the independently selected scored DMSO_T0 profile, compare the exact released differential score and sample/line/signature key with the oracle; require value_status=scored, is_time_zero=true, contrast_kind=time_zero_vs_endpoint and is_control_reference=false. Explain the baseline-versus-endpoint contrast relative to the mean matched DMSO_TF endpoint controls, not a drug-treatment effect or a second control subtraction.

cases.title: Bounded single-cell raw data
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay cell barcode {cell_barcode}, inspect a small raw-count slice and show how stored entries differ from nonzero entries. Keep sparse arrays aligned; I do not need a full matrix export.

hard_criteria.assertion: Read current public aliases/schema from the guide and send dataset=emerald-bay with a selective barcode filter and explicit bound.
Compare returned barcode, gene tokens, raw integers and entry counts with the independent oracle; preserve explicit stored zero and array alignment.
Do not call the pseudobulk convenience tool a single-cell read, scan the complete matrix, or seek files outside advertised tables.

cases.title: Unsupported scientific layers
cases.prompt: In Emerald Bay, can you give me DESeq2-normalized expression and differential-expression results, absolute VISION scores, embedding distances and perturbation markers? Explain the supported alternatives without changing datasets.

hard_criteria.assertion: Explicitly state all requested layers are unavailable for Emerald Bay; do not infer availability from tool names shared with Tahoe-100M.
Offer raw/CPM/log1p pseudobulk, released growth and differential VISION as different supported measurements, not equivalent replacements.
Do not call excluded tables or attempt to obtain unsupported data via run_sql; never switch silently to Tahoe-100M.
If a caller explicitly tests a shared unsupported tool, retain its Emerald refusal and do not present it as a successful analysis.

cases.title: Older server compatibility
cases.prompt: Use Tara to analyze Emerald Bay expression for {positive_gene}. If this server cannot serve Emerald Bay, say so clearly. Do not answer with Tahoe-100M values.

hard_criteria.assertion: The supplied compatibility fixture represents a pre-0.4.0 Tahoe-only server; inspect metadata before data retrieval.
Report Emerald unavailable and make no Emerald data calls or fabricated dataset argument fallback.
Keep existing Tahoe capability available when the user separately requests Tahoe; do not require an upgrade for legacy supported work.

cases.title: Disabled or unauthorized release
cases.prompt: Analyze Emerald Bay with Tara. If it is not available to this account, explain what you can establish without guessing why it is hidden.

hard_criteria.assertion: When Emerald is absent from account-visible capabilities, report it unavailable to this account; do not infer whether it is disabled, private or unauthorized.
Do not retry with another dataset, identity, endpoint, SQL locator or credentials.
Existing advertised Tahoe tools still work for an explicit separate Tahoe request; do not confuse Emerald gating with a whole-service outage.

cases.title: Missing or inconsistent capability metadata
cases.prompt: Use Tara for Emerald Bay CPM and pathways. Verify that the requested features are actually advertised before using them.

hard_criteria.assertion: Run fixture variants for missing Emerald, missing measurement, missing tool and inconsistent release/guide metadata.
Fail closed for the unavailable or inconsistent capability, even when server_version is 0.4.0 or newer.
Do not manufacture capability from a version string or a remembered guide; preserve a specific limitation in the answer.

cases.title: Mixed-dataset intent
cases.prompt: Compare Emerald Bay and Tahoe-100M for {shared_gene}. Use each dataset's own expression definition, and explain whether the values can be pooled directly.

hard_criteria.assertion: Confirm the user intends both datasets; retrieve each with explicit selection and its own guide, release and provenance.
Use separate dataset-scoped queries and result tables; never issue a cross-dataset SQL join or reuse a pending handle across datasets.
Compare each side to an independent dataset-specific oracle and explain population, normalization, condition and control differences.
Do not pool unmatched measurements or transfer Tahoe frozen values, annotations or biological claims to Emerald.

Report no numeric cross-dataset delta: do not subtract, ratio or otherwise combine Emerald and Tahoe-100M values, and state that no conversion between the two is provided. Compare direction or rank within each dataset only.

cases.title: Truncation and complete conclusions
cases.prompt: For Emerald Bay sample {measured_sample}, report {positive_gene} pseudobulk expression across the cell-line panel, preserving unavailable states. Start with get_expression_slice limit=1 so we can inspect truncation. Use a complete bounded response or a bounded SQL aggregate before drawing a panel-wide conclusion; otherwise explain the incomplete scope.

hard_criteria.assertion: Request the bounded single-sample, single-gene slice with limit=1 and observe truncated=true, complete=false and a truncation reason; do not invent truncation evidence.

Read truncated, complete and truncation_reasons; obtain a complete bounded response or bounded SQL aggregate for panel-wide claims and compare it to the independent oracle. Never reconstruct a large export through repeated partitions to bypass output limits.
Avoid duplicate keys and do not infer global extrema or coverage from a truncated prefix.
If completion cannot be obtained within limits, state the incomplete scope and leave the case blocked or failed rather than claiming success.

cases.title: Pending and fetch with stable arguments
cases.prompt: Retrieve Emerald Bay expression for {positive_gene} at {measured_sample}/{cell_line}. If Tara returns pending, fetch that same result and preserve its scientific context.

hard_criteria.assertion: A real pending response and subsequent successful fetch must be captured; synchronous completion alone is BLOCKED for this case.
Reuse the same tool, dataset, release context and effective arguments with result_handle; do not resubmit a new query or swap measurements.
Preserve pending and final release/guide/measurement provenance; compare final results with the independent oracle.
Keep result/cancellation handles out of public evidence and never expose another account's output.

cases.title: Cancel an owned pending query
cases.prompt: Start the approved bounded Emerald Bay query {cancellation_query_label}. If it is pending, cancel my query and confirm its final state. Do not make the query expensive merely to force a cancellation.

hard_criteria.assertion: Observe a real owned pending query, then use only its cancel_handle; never another user's handle.
Confirm a terminal canceled state, then an allowed bounded follow-up read; a query that finished first does not prove cancellation.
Do not relax limits, manufacture expensive work or treat a pending cancellation receipt as terminal.
If no safe pending query occurs, record BLOCKED; do not represent a simulated cancellation as a live pass.

cases.title: Citations and transformations
cases.prompt: Using the verified Emerald Bay expression and growth results for {measured_sample}/{cell_line}, write a brief reusable methods note with attribution, normalization, populations, controls and limitations. Do not reproduce the runtime guide.

hard_criteria.assertion: Cite Tahoe Bio and the public EmeraldBay dataset; link CC BY 4.0, identify transformations, and record source revision, release and guide_version.
Identify CPM/log1p derivation, exact sample/line grain, separate QC populations, control rule, missingness and completeness.
Keep Tahoe CC0, plugin Apache-2.0, documentation CC BY 4.0 and runtime-guide rights distinct.
No source guide is redistributed; do not publish credentials, handles, account IDs or unapproved deployment details in the evidence.

cases.title: Explicitly authorized synthetic feedback
cases.prompt: Send Tara this clearly labeled synthetic evaluation feedback: "SYNTHETIC EMERALD PLUGIN EVALUATION: approved tool check, not a scientific finding." Report whether it was received.

hard_criteria.assertion: Run only when the operator has separately approved this feedback submission in the live window.
Send the exact synthetic content through send_feedback once and verify the received receipt; do not invent a successful submission.
Without approval or when quota prevents submission, record BLOCKED and do not send feedback by another route.
